Paragraph:
Translation: In the beginning of creation, the Lord of all creatures sent forth generations of men and demigods, along with sacrifices for Visnu, and blessed them by saying, "Be thou happy by this yajna [sacrifice] because its performance will bestow upon you all desirable things."

Purport (Excerpt): The material creation... is a chance offered to the conditioned souls to come back home... The Lord created this material world for the conditioned souls to learn how to perform yajnas... so that while in the material world they can live very comfortably without anxiety. Then after finishing the present material body, they can enter into the kingdom of God...
Situation/Problem_Faced: Understanding the fundamental design of the universe and how living beings can thrive without anxiety.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna recounts how the Creator (Prajapati) instituted the principle of sacrifice (Yajna) at the dawn of creation as the mechanism for prosperity, harmony, and ultimate liberation.
Outcome/Resolution: Arjuna learns that life is structurally designed to work through reciprocal sacrifice, not isolated selfishness.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Reciprocity and Cooperation: Recognizing that human thriving relies on mutual sacrifice and contribution
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Living Without Anxiety: Achieving peace by aligning with natural cosmic design
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Systemic Harmony: Integrating personal effort into a larger collective system

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Yajna-bhavana (The spirit of sacrifice as the engine of creation)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: At creation, Prajapati linked humanity's prosperity to Yajna (sacrifice). By performing selfless sacrifices for the Supreme, living entities meet their needs, live comfortably without anxiety, and gradually qualify to return to the spiritual world.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Isolation and greed run counter to psychological well-being. Human life is built on systems of mutual support and sacrifice. When individuals contribute selflessly to their community and environment, they tap into a sustainable ecosystem of prosperity and mental security.
